title: case_unit_price never populated on order lines
current: case_unit_price is NULL on all sampled order lines; only unit_price (each price) is populated.
expected: When a Double UOM product has a Case Price defined, case_unit_price should be populated on the order line.
business_impact: High - case pricing is not applied to orders, risking revenue loss or incorrect invoicing.
root_cause: The pricing calculation endpoint does not return or apply case pricing.
why_today: (inferred) enableCasePricing defaults OFF and case price is derived from each price x factor, so case_unit_price was never wired into the order-creation pricing flow.
why_not_prod: (inferred) Most tenants keep case pricing OFF, so invoices compute from each price x factor and stay correct; only tenants using independent case prices are affected.
customer_impact: Tenants using independent case pricing get wrong order/invoice values.
suggested_fix: Extend pricing logic to look up and apply case price when the order line has case_quantity > 0.
existing_notes: Evidence: order-line sample shows 100% NULL case_unit_price.
